verdict.line: You lose if you trade into full Runic Blade stacks before level 6; you win if you survive to Fury of the Sands and she has no way to finish you quickly.

brief.thesis: Riven's whole kit is a burst window gated by Q (Broken Wings) and W (Ki Burst) cooldowns and Runic Blade charge-up; Nasus has no way to interrupt that window and only scales out of it. The data confirms it: Riven holds lane and solo-kill advantage (809 games), with Nasus clawing the overall matchup back to 50.2% purely through scaling, not lane dominance.

theirWindow.when: W (Ki Burst) up and she's near
theirWindow.what: She can stun you with Ki Burst (11/10/9/8/7s cooldown) and chain Q (Broken Wings) resets into empowered autos off Runic Blade. Do not stand still in range 260 of her when this is up — back off and farm with Q (Siphoning Strike) from max range 255 instead.

yourWindow.when: her E (Valor) and W (Ki Burst) both down
yourWindow.what: This is the only safe window to actually trade — she has no stun and no dash-block available. Walk up, land Siphoning Strike, and disengage before Wither (W, cooldown 15/14/13/12/11s) is even worth using offensively.

start.why: 51.4% win rate over 603 games — the extra base health and regen is built for absorbing Riven's burst windows while you farm Siphoning Strike at range.

boots.why: 48.9% over 438 games — the auto-attack damage reduction directly cuts the empowered Runic Blade autos she leans on to finish trades.

core.why: Part of the highest-performing path (58.1% over 117 games) — gives you the stats to actually win trades once stacked instead of just surviving them.
Attack speed slow directly punishes her reliance on landing empowered autos between dashes.
Completes the 58.1% win-rate path — boosted healing from Soul Eater lifesteal turns slow siege trades in your favor.

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustain and movement speed proc lets you disengage out of her Ki Burst/Broken Wings combo range instead of getting locked down for the full chain.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the best winrate here (57.5% over 438 games) — Flash gives you a hard out from her all-in windows, and Teleport keeps you relevant for Fury of the Sands sieges after inevitably losing early waves to her pressure.

playing.title: Farm Q from max range only
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike has 255 range; stay at the edge of that and never step into her 260 Ki Burst radius unless her W is on cooldown.

playing.title: Track Runic Blade stacks, not just HP
playing.detail: Her empowered autos scale with Passive charge — if she's been using abilities freely, her next 1-2 autos hit much harder than they look.

playing.title: Never trade into double dash
playing.detail: Broken Wings (Q) can be reactivated three times, with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies. If she has two or more charges left, disengage rather than committing to a stand-and-fight trade.

playing.title: Hold Wither for her all-in, not poke
playing.detail: W (Wither, cooldown 15/14/13/12/11s) slows her Movement and Attack Speed — save it for the moment she commits Q and E together, not as a chip-damage poke tool.

playing.title: Level 6 is your first real contest
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands grants bonus health and max-health drain damage; this is the first level you can threaten a trade instead of just surviving one.

playing.title: Use Spirit Fire to zone, not initiate
playing.detail: E (Spirit Fire) reduces armor in its area — drop it on the spot she wants to dash into so her follow-up trades cost more, rather than using it to start fights yourself.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not lane kills
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read confirms it: keep distance, stack Q, and use Fury of the Sands as your equalizer rather than contesting her level 1-5 all-in windows.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning — cooldown windows, stack tracking, and trade timing — is my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep your distance from Riven while paying close attention to her Conqueror stack count. Focus on farming with [Q] to stack up rather than engaging Riven. After reaching level 6, try to use Fury of the Sands [R] + Unsealed Spellbook to gain the upper hand.
